$comment: PURPOSE AND SHAPE: This recipe projects stable identity and queryable facets into properties while keeping long-form prose in the Markdown body. title and control_id remain properties; curie is emitted automatically from the ontology plus identifier. The body starts with the control name, then places normative control text and discussion in separate readable sections. RIGHTS: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 is a public-domain United States Government work. Corpus provenance and rights posture: https://cybersader.github.io/crosswalker/reference/framework-corpus/. KNOWN GAP — related is intentionally not emitted because the current recipe grammar cannot produce a clean, faithful result: (1) template filters operate on a scalar and cannot split/map/reject every list item; (2) managed frontmatter templates cannot turn a CSV scalar into a CURIE array; (3) managed_links can split only into wikilinks and cannot normalize each item by stripping the terminal period, rejecting the [None] sentinel, or prefixing each identifier as nist-800-53:<id>; (4) body projections cannot expand the list into per-item resolving wikilinks, and Tier 2 concept projection does not turn arbitrary related properties into mappings traversed by closure. Emitting half-broken links such as [[SC-37.]] or [[[None]]] would be worse than omitting them until the schema supports a portable per-item transform and relationship projection.
